name: Extract HTML Table
description: Extracts a tabular dataset from the current page into structured JSON (array of row objects keyed by header). Works on real <table> elements and on ARIA grid/role-based tables. Includes data sanity checks (the doc's 'validation beyond binary success/failure').

selector.description: CSS selector for the table; defaults to the first/largest table on the page

headers.description: comma-separated header names to use instead of auto-detecting them

output.rows: array of objects, one per data row, keyed by column header

known_issues: Tables built from nested divs without role=grid/row/cell are not detected; use --selector and the table must use real <tr>/<td> or ARIA roles.
Merged cells (colspan/rowspan) are flattened naively and may misalign columns.
